ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.name: Maine Supreme Judicial Court — Law Court (simulated alternate-history bench)
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.jurisdiction: Maine statewide; court of last resort; appeals from Superior, District, Probate and certain administrative actions; case-specific review required
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.role: Associate Justice of the Maine Supreme Judicial Court, appellate Law Court capacity
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.appeal_route: State court of last resort; further federal judicial review only where legally available and independently verified
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.appointment: Maine Governor appointment; Senate confirmation; seven-year term; assumed fictional oath/start must be supported before active campaign
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.staffing: Seven judicial seats (one Chief Justice, six Associate Justices); law clerks serve full Court but have chamber assignments; clerk of the Law Court manages appellate docket
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.rules: Maine Rules of Appellate Procedure effective November 2024 (2B,7,7A,8,11,12,12A), Maine Rules of Civil Procedure effective June 2026 (56), Code of Judicial Conduct September 2024 (2.9,2.11), applicable court orders and eCourts requirements; check fact-specific exceptions
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.judicial_power: Questions of law on appeals; published decisions bind Maine lower courts; administrative rulemaking and narrow constitutional advisory role
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.location: Portland chambers selected for player, Maine; arguments normally Cumberland County Courthouse unless announced otherwise
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.opinion_workflow: Record and briefing -> oral argument only if ordered, otherwise consideration on briefs -> qualified justices consider the appeal under Rule 12 (majority of qualified sitting justices) -> draft/revisions/positions tracked separately -> signed or per curiam opinion, or nonprecedential memorandum; simulated internal assignment not asserted as real practice
ME-SJC-LAW-COURT.ethical_boundaries: Rule 2.9 prohibits unauthorized ex parte communications and independent factual inquiry; Rule 2.11 requires recusal for qualifying impartiality concerns; counsel conflicts review prior to case consideration

court_research_completion.scope: Law Court appellate operations and initial civil contract-interpretation appeal only
limitations: entire in-simulation roster fictitious and alternate-history; no real vacancy represented
confidential internal vote and opinion assignment methods not publicly verified; simulation mechanics are not claims about actual procedures
case-specific conflicts, jurisdiction and legal developments must be reviewed before merits activity
no comprehensive subsequent-treatment search for cited precedents
